name: Lotus Horizon Holdings Limited
summary: Lotus Horizon Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides design, supply, and installation services for façade and building metal finishing works in Hong Kong. The company offers customized system design for façade works and building metal finishing works, shop drawings, sourcing and procurement of materials, material fabrication and processing, on-site installation works, performance testing, and post-installation maintenance services. It also provides corporate management services. The company offers its services for commercial properties, residential properties, and public facilities.
